# Exploratory testing charter

## Mission
Explore **[feature or workflow]** to learn how it behaves when **[user, condition, or risk]** matters.

## Time box
[30–60 minutes]

## Useful starting questions
- What should a user be able to complete?
- What could interrupt, confuse, or mislead them?
- Which data, permissions, devices, or integrations change the behavior?
- What evidence would make a finding useful to the team?

## Notes
- Observations:
- Questions:
- Risks or defects:
- Follow-up coverage:
